description: Compare the HPO phenotype profiles of the three ATP6AP2 allelic entities and quantify their overlap
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# HPO annotation sets retrieved from ontology.jax.org (iteration 2) for the three allelic entities
hpo = {
"MRXSH (OMIM 300423 / MONDO:0010319)": [
 ("HP:0001249","Intellectual disability","Nervous"),("HP:0001263","Global developmental delay","Nervous"),
 ("HP:0001270","Motor delay","Nervous"),("HP:0000750","Delayed speech and language development","Nervous"),
 ("HP:0001250","Seizure","Nervous"),("HP:0002069","Bilateral tonic-clonic seizure","Nervous"),
 ("HP:0001288","Gait disturbance","Nervous"),("HP:0002527","Falls","Nervous"),
 ("HP:0031629","Impaired tandem gait","Nervous"),("HP:0001272","Cerebellar atrophy","Brain MRI"),
 ("HP:0002059","Cerebral atrophy","Brain MRI"),("HP:0033725","Thin corpus callosum","Brain MRI"),
 ("HP:0002079","Hypoplasia of the corpus callosum","Brain MRI"),("HP:0002188","Delayed CNS myelination","Brain MRI"),
 ("HP:0001300","Parkinsonism","Nervous"),("HP:0002067","Bradykinesia","Nervous"),
 ("HP:0002345","Action tremor","Nervous"),("HP:0002063","Rigidity","Muscle"),
 ("HP:0001257","Spasticity","Muscle"),("HP:0003487","Babinski sign","Nervous"),
 ("HP:0001265","Hyporeflexia","Nervous"),("HP:0002186","Apraxia","Nervous"),
 ("HP:0010527","Astereognosis","Nervous"),("HP:0011812","Agraphesthesia","Nervous"),
 ("HP:0001350","Slurred speech","Nervous"),("HP:0002307","Drooling","Head/neck"),
 ("HP:0000338","Hypomimic face","Head/neck"),("HP:0000341","Narrow forehead","Head/neck"),
 ("HP:0003593","Infantile onset","Course"),("HP:0003623","Neonatal onset","Course"),
 ("HP:0001419","X-linked recessive inheritance","Inheritance")],
"XPDS (OMIM 300911 / MONDO:0010482)": [
 ("HP:0001300","Parkinsonism","Nervous"),("HP:0002067","Bradykinesia","Nervous"),
 ("HP:0002322","Resting tremor","Nervous"),("HP:0002396","Cogwheel rigidity","Muscle"),
 ("HP:0001257","Spasticity","Muscle"),("HP:0001347","Hyperreflexia","Nervous"),
 ("HP:0003487","Babinski sign","Nervous"),("HP:0000338","Hypomimic face","Head/neck"),
 ("HP:0003621","Juvenile onset","Course"),("HP:0025709","Intermediate young adult onset","Course"),
 ("HP:0003596","Middle age onset","Course"),("HP:0003677","Slowly progressive","Course"),
 ("HP:0001419","X-linked recessive inheritance","Inheritance")],
"ATP6AP2-CDG / CDG-IIr (OMIM 301045 / MONDO:0026765)": [
 ("HP:0012301","Type II transferrin isoform profile","Lab"),("HP:0001397","Hepatic steatosis","Lab/Liver"),
 ("HP:0002910","Elevated hepatic transaminases","Lab"),("HP:0002240","Hepatomegaly","Liver"),
 ("HP:0001413","Micronodular cirrhosis","Liver"),("HP:0001410","Decreased liver function","Liver"),
 ("HP:0000952","Jaundice","Liver"),("HP:0001541","Ascites","Liver"),
 ("HP:0002719","Recurrent infections","Immune"),("HP:0032218","Decreased CD4+ T cell proportion","Immune"),
 ("HP:0004313","Decreased circulating immunoglobulin","Immune"),("HP:0000973","Cutis laxa","Skin"),
 ("HP:0000047","Hypospadias","Genitourinary"),("HP:0000347","Micrognathia","Head/neck"),
 ("HP:0000369","Low-set ears","Head/neck"),("HP:0003593","Infantile onset","Course"),
 ("HP:0001419","X-linked recessive inheritance","Inheritance")],
}

rows = [{"entity": e, "hpo_id": i, "term": t, "system": s} for e, L in hpo.items() for i, t, s in L]
df = pd.DataFrame(rows)

# shared vs private terms
counts = df.groupby("hpo_id").entity.nunique()
df["shared_in"] = df.hpo_id.map(counts)
print("Annotation counts per entity:\n", df.groupby("entity").size())
print("\nTerms shared by 2 or more entities:")
print(df[df.shared_in > 1][["hpo_id","term","entity"]].sort_values("hpo_id").to_string(index=False))

# --- figure: system-level phenotype profile of the three allelic entities ---
sysorder = ["Nervous","Brain MRI","Muscle","Head/neck","Course","Inheritance",
            "Liver","Lab","Lab/Liver","Immune","Skin","Genitourinary"]
mat = (df.groupby(["entity","system"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
         .reindex(columns=sysorder, fill_value=0))
mat = mat.reindex(list(hpo.keys()))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12.5, 4.2))
bottom = np.zeros(len(mat))
cmap = plt.get_cmap("tab20")
for k, s in enumerate(sysorder):
    vals = mat[s].values
    ax.barh(range(len(mat)), vals, left=bottom, label=s, color=cmap(k % 20), edgecolor="white")
    for i, val in enumerate(vals):
        if val:
            ax.text(bottom[i] + val/2, i, str(val), ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8)
    bottom += vals
ax.set_yticks(range(len(mat)))
ax.set_yticklabels([m.replace(" (", "\n(") for m in mat.index], fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("number of HPO terms annotated (source: ontology.jax.org, HPOA)")
ax.set_title("HPO profiles of the three ATP6AP2 allelic entities: the two splicing diseases are\n"
             "purely neurological, the missense disease is hepatic, immune and dermatological")
ax.legend(ncol=6, fontsize=7.5, frameon=False, loc="lower center", bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.42))
for sp in ["top","right","left"]: ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print(f"\nTotal distinct HPO terms across the ATP6AP2-related disorder grouping: {df.hpo_id.nunique()}")
print(f"Overlap between MRXSH and XPDS: {len(set(df[df.entity.str.startswith('MRXSH')].hpo_id) & set(df[df.entity.str.startswith('XPDS')].hpo_id))} shared terms")
print(f"Overlap between neurological entities and ATP6AP2-CDG (excluding inheritance/course): "
      f"{len((set(df[df.entity.str.startswith('MRXSH')].hpo_id) | set(df[df.entity.str.startswith('XPDS')].hpo_id)) & set(df[df.entity.str.contains('CDG')].hpo_id) - {'HP:0001419','HP:0003593'})}")
